author: Claude
topic: Upload-only Google Apps Script web app receiving original Android photos into a Drive folder, with PC watcher notification
existing_manual_gap: No manual covered Apps Script web app doPost, Drive folder file creation, MailApp owner notification, or Android camera-intent original capture without storage/camera permissions.
browser: ego-browser (project rule), page innerText read in full for the first four; MediaStore reference read for the named constants only

sources.scope: requirements, doGet/doPost event object fields, reserved parameters c/sid, deploy steps, test /dev URL, execute-as permissions, OAuth token caution

sources.scope: consumer vs Workspace quotas and limits table, exception messages

sources.title: Apps Script reference: Drive Folder

sources.title: Android reference: MediaStore
sources.scope: ACTION_IMAGE_CAPTURE (EXTRA_OUTPUT full size, CAMERA permission note), ACTION_VIDEO_CAPTURE, EXTRA_DURATION_LIMIT, ACTION_PICK_IMAGES, EXTRA_PICK_IMAGES_MAX

sources.title: Android guide: Photo picker
sources.scope: availability API30+/backport, multiple selection limit, access lifetime and persistable grants, HDR transcoding opt-in

cross_check: doPost body is text only (postData.contents) -> base64 for binary; matched with Utilities/Folder.createFile(blob) usage.
Quota page lists no web-app request body size limit -> treated as unknown; conservative 4 MiB raw chunks.
Photo picker grants end at app stop -> copy original bytes immediately for resumable upload.
MediaStore note: declared-but-ungranted CAMERA permission breaks ACTION_IMAGE_CAPTURE -> do not declare CAMERA.
applied_to: MAY wallet photo send app candidate (private project), 2026-11-21
